legal_relevance: Distinguishes war crimes from ordinary crimes or human-rights violations
examples: Attack on civilians, prisoner abuse, unlawful deportation, prohibited weapons use

legal_relevance: Identifies victims and objects protected by IHL
examples: Civilians, POWs, wounded and sick, hospitals, humanitarian personnel

legal_relevance: Separates grave breaches and serious IHL violations from minor breaches
examples: Willful killing, torture, inhuman treatment, extensive destruction

legal_relevance: Links senior officials to crimes committed by subordinates
examples: Failure to prevent, repress, investigate, or punish crimes
